rows.grounds: noun denoting the cakra being described
numeral forming first member of compound with patra
noun forming second member of compound with aṣṭa

items.question: What specific attributes characterize the sixth cakra in this sequence?
premises: The verse introduces the sixth cakra.
This cakra is described as royal.
This cakra is described as having eight petals.
This cakra is described as possessing a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is identified as a royal eight-petaled wheel with a pericarp.
uncertainties: The exact intended sense of rājānam as an epithet for the neuter cakraṃ is contextually inferred.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is royal, with eight petals and a pericarp.
